verdict.rationale: Stable documents a REST API (x-api-key authentication, endpoints such as GET /v1/locations/{id}, webhooks), but nothing in the evidence mentions an official SDK or client library in any language. Every OpenAPI spec path probed returned 404, so there is also no evidence of a spec from which clients could be generated. For an API-bearing SaaS product the SDK axis applies, and absence of evidence makes this 'none'.
